title: "District Map"

  html:
    page-layout: full
    resources:
      - "files/other/ca_senate_districts.geojson"
execute:

  warning: false
  message: false
---

This is a map of each state Senate district. Feel free to click on any district to go to the senator's webpage.

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(htmlwidgets)
source("scripts/shared.R")

districts <- st_read("files/other/ca_senate_districts.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

senators <- load_senators() |>
  mutate(display_name = paste(Last.Name, First.Name, sep = ", "))

districts <- left_join(districts, senators, by = c("district" = "District"))

# Esri's gray canvas needs no API key (Carto's tiles now watermark
# keyless use) and suits the muted paper palette. Its matching
# REFERENCE layer adds city/place names for orientation — drawn in a
# high pane so the labels float above the district fills (tile layers
# don't catch clicks, so the districts stay clickable).
map <- leaflet(districts) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
  addMapPane("place-labels", zIndex = 650) |>
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    attribution = "Labels © Esri",
    options = tileOptions(pane = "place-labels")
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "#17345a",
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    dashArray = "1",
    layerId = ~district,
    highlight = highlightOptions(
      weight = 4,
      color = "#d4a821",
      dashArray = "",
      fillOpacity = 0.7,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~paste("District", district, display_name),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  setView(lng = -120, lat = 36.5, zoom = 5)

# Clicking a district opens that senator's page. The click is bound to each
# polygon layer itself, so it lands on the exact district shape (not a
# bounding box), and the URL is relative so it works wherever the site lives.
map |>
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      this.eachLayer(function(layer) {
        if (layer.options && layer.options.layerId) {
          layer.on('click', function() {
            window.open('senator-pages/district_' + layer.options.layerId + '.html', '_blank');
          });
        }
      });
    }
  ")
```
